references.text: The Levites were appointed to carry the holy objects, including the ark of the covenant.
The tribe of Levi was set apart to carry the Lord's ark of the covenant.
Moses gave the law to the Levites who carried the Lord's ark of the covenant.
Levitical priests carried the Lord's ark of the covenant across the Jordan.
Joshua commanded the priests to carry the ark of the covenant, just as Moses had ordered.
The Levites took down the Lord's ark and carried it, in accordance with their duty.
David confirmed that only the Levites should carry God's ark.
The Levites carried God's ark on their shoulders using poles, as Moses had commanded.
